question: What 2024 net income did Bank of America originally report, what does its 2025 annual report now show for 2024, and why the difference?
answer: Bank of America originally reported 2024 net income of $27,132 million in its 2024 annual report (Form 10-K). Its 2025 annual report now shows 2024 net income of $26,973 million. The difference is a decrease of $159 million, resulting from retrospective adjustments or restatements reported in the 2025 Form 10-K.
